description: Kary Kon Trzyglowa, the huge black sacred horse of the three-headed god Triglav, a bold simple silhouette, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, one big powerful black horse body, three horse heads on three thick necks rising from the shoulders, clearly separated and spread apart like a fan, each head with a long horse muzzle and bright glowing silver eyes, strong blue-silver rim light along the heads, necks, back and legs, a flowing black mane, no saddle, no rider, no straps, no harness, no ornaments, striding forward, menacing, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no rocks, no ground, no background, the whole creature inside the picture with space below the hooves, all three heads whole
